latest.notes: Log generation underfill fixes. (1) Hours landing within a minute of the top no longer warn as underfilled — that's the fluid top of hour, by design. (2) When an hour's own clock rotation runs dry, the scheduler now tops it up from the Auto-Fill clock (Settings > Scheduling), music only, falling back to all airable music — so hours fill instead of just warning. An hour is flagged underfilled only when there's genuinely no music left to fill it.
